title: Gateway Analytics
description: Tenant analytics read from the durable usage ledger to show current activity, policy blocks, and provider/model concentration.
tiles.activeUsers.label: Active users / 30d
tiles.activeUsers.description: Unique users who generated usage in the last 30 days.
tiles.distinctUsers.label: Distinct gateway users / 24h
tiles.distinctUsers.description: Unique users seen in the last 24 hours.
tiles.requests.label: Gateway requests / 7d
tiles.requests.description: Total requests accepted or blocked by the gateway over 7 days.
tiles.blocked.label: Blocked requests / 7d
tiles.blocked.description: Requests refused by policy, quota, or other gateway guardrails.
tiles.cost.label: Estimated cost / 30d
tiles.cost.description: Approximate spend based on recorded usage events and provider cost estimation.
ledgerDescription: The usage ledger groups requests by tenant, provider, and model. Policy or quota blocks are counted separately so you can see when the gateway intentionally refused a request.
loading.title: Loading analytics
loading.description: The usage ledger is being aggregated for the active tenant.
error.title: Analytics unavailable
error.description: The control plane could not load tenant analytics from the usage ledger.
provider.title: Usage by provider
provider.help: Breaks activity down by provider so you can see where traffic, cost, and blocks concentrate.
model.title: Usage by model
model.help: Shows which specific models are being used within each provider and how much activity each model receives.
